title: A project API key needs a read scope for what it includes
why: Includes, related filters and counts used to answer with only the list's scope. A key without the related read scope now gets 403.
changelog: a project API key needs a read scope
steps: List the resources each project API key reaches through `include`, related filters and `count`.
Create a key with a read scope for each of them (`brain backend keys create --scopes ...`) and replace the old key.
